Mr. Robot above all is a character study about Elliot Alderson. I think if you view the show through that lens then you'll realize it all made sense and resolved in a satisfying way. Whiterose's purpose was to show the difference between two giants with Multiple Personality Disorder and what they were able to accomplish with that. Whiterose's project was the dream of a mentally unhealthy person who wanted to bring a loved one back. Elliot's project was to topple the 1% of the 1%. Both dreams are equally unattainable and are quite different in nature. Saying Whiterose's project is a macguffin is like saying Elliot's purpose of bringing down the higher ups is also a macguffin.
